title: Closing an account: only at zero or with its money moved out, and its schedules end on the closing day
written_in: SCHEMA_V3 3, 5; DECISIONS_ROUND2 O (close, never delete), P6
notes: Every amount is made up and in whole minor units (yen).

Question `close` [P6]: closing `account` on `date` with its final figure `figure` (the final `check`). `transfers` are the transfers out that the closing asks for, `{ to, a }`. The account closes only when the figure less the transfers is zero; otherwise the closing is refused and `left` shows what is still in it. On a close the answer gives `closed` (the date), the events written (the final `check`, then each transfer, all dated the closing day) and `ends`: each schedule of the account (paid from it, landing in it, or a transfer into it) with its new `ends`, the closing day, unless it already ends on or before that day. Other schedules are untouched.

cases.question: close
cases.title: An account at zero closes; its bill ends on the closing day
cases.why: The final figure is 0, so nothing has to move out and the account closes [P6]. The gym is paid from it, so its schedule ends on Fri 8 Jan; the pay lands in the main bank and is untouched.

cases.question: close
cases.title: 30,000 left, moved out by the transfer the closing asks for: it closes
cases.why: 30,000 (final figure) - 30,000 (moved to the main bank) = 0, so it closes [P6]. The final check holds the figure; the transfer moves it out on the same day. As scenarios/account_closed.json.

cases.question: close
cases.title: Money left and no transfer: the closing is refused
cases.why: 30,000 is still in it and nothing moves it out, so it is not closed [P6]; the 30,000 is shown and nothing is written.

cases.question: close
cases.title: A transfer that moves out only part: refused, with what is still in it
cases.why: 30,000 - 20,000 = 10,000 still in it, which is not zero, so it is not closed [P6].

cases.question: close
cases.title: A transfer of more than the final figure: refused
cases.why: 30,000 - 35,000 = -5,000: the transfer would take 5,000 the account does not hold, so it is not zero and the closing is refused [P6].

cases.question: close
cases.title: Every schedule of the account ends on the closing day; one that already ended keeps its end
cases.why: The gym (paid from it, ending 31 Dec), a side income landing in it and a top-up transfer into it from the main bank are its schedules: each ends on Fri 8 Jan [P6]. The phone already ended on 5 Jan, before the closing day, and keeps that end. The rent is paid from the main bank and is untouched.

open.question: A card, pay-later or loan closed while something is still owed on it, or a bank closed below zero: P6 speaks of a figure moved out by a transfer. Is closing refused until it is paid to zero, or does the closing ask for a payment into it?
open.ref_does: `close` takes a final figure and transfers out only; no case closes an owed account.

open.question: Closing the account a card is paid from (`payFrom`), or the account a goal or other kept place is kept in (`keptIn.acct`): does the closing ask for a new paying account and move the place's money, or is it refused?
open.ref_does: `close` looks only at the account's figure and schedules; no case has a card or a place on the closing account.

open.question: A 38.31 account that is already closed with a figure that is not zero, at the move: how is it brought in?
open.ref_does: Nothing; the move (SCHEMA_V3 section 11) is not part of this file.
